groups.distinction: Validate a flat CIF loop's rectangular cardinality, case-insensitive data names, required columns, and declared row ceiling without padding absent cells.
Resolve only declared symmetry-code identifiers and preserve their three shift digits and expression as literals; never evaluate an expression or infer structure identity.
Calculate explicitly weighted synthetic reflection groups while preserving all source members, literal Miller indices, and rejection reasons; no symmetry merging or statistical inference.
Carry a declared absolute interval bound for synthetic detector distance, convert its endpoints exactly, and refuse zero-crossing geometry and undeclared uncertainty interpretations.
Check a declared forward/reverse integer cell-setting pair as exact inverses, without inferring specimen identity or scientific equivalence.
Verify an ordered synthetic image-byte capsule from declared chunks, exact length, and SHA-256; reject reordering, gaps, and over-budget reconstruction without handling a real image.
Compute exact determinant, handedness, and dual-basis coefficients for a supplied finite rational basis while refusing singular geometry and empirical promotion.
Compare keyed synthetic CIF rows under an explicit ordered or keyed relation; preserve duplicate-key ambiguity and distinguish cell changes from serialization order.
Parse bounded CIF numeric tokens with standard-uncertainty digits while preserving absent, unknown, inapplicable, and quoted literal states; never invent a measured structure factor.
Preview an append-only rollback event only for a verified ancestor snapshot with matching current readback and retention; classify missing evidence and real release authority separately.
